# 0.1.198 - Fix: white screen on all Pages apps + backend-unavailable fallbacks

**Incident:** `https://trance-0.github.io/Notechondria/{portal,editor,planner}/`
stayed blank. Every load logged
`flutter_bootstrap.js: ReferenceError: e is not defined`; `main.dart.js` was
never requested. The backend was healthy throughout.

## Root cause

`.github/workflows/frontend-pages.yml:130` (0.1.196's service-worker strip).
`flutter_bootstrap.js` inlines the SDK's whole `flutter.js` before the
generated `_flutter.loader.load({...})` call. The minified-variable regex
`serviceWorkerSettings\s*:\s*[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\s*,?` also matched the loader's
own method signature, `async load({serviceWorkerSettings:e,...})`, so the
body's later use of `e` threw and `load()` never fetched the app. The
whole-file assert on line 131 (`'serviceWorkerSettings' not in text`) could
only pass by corrupting the loader. CI stayed green because the smoke tests
run in the Dart VM and never execute the bootstrap JS.

## Fix

- The strip step now edits only the call site after the inlined loader
  (split on `//# sourceMappingURL=flutter.js.map`). It asserts that the
  inlined loader is byte-identical to `build/web/flutter.js` and that the
  call site no longer carries `serviceWorkerSettings`. Messages are
  `Pages bundle not published: frontend-pages/strip-service-worker (<app>) - <cause>`.
  The self-destroying `flutter_service_worker.js` and the
  `STRIP_SERVICE_WORKER` switch are unchanged.

## No more silent or blank startup states

- **Bounded startup requests** (`notechondria_shared/lib/src/startup/startup_budget.dart`).
  Cold start (session restore, OAuth exchange, initial data, deep links), the
  banner's Retry, and its Work offline run inside a `StartupRequestBudget`.
  `HttpClientInternalsMixin.send` enforces it: each request gets 10s, and the
  first timeout fails the remaining requests of that pass immediately. An
  unresponsive backend therefore ends in the banner after about 10s instead
  of an empty shell that never finishes loading. Requests started from user
  actions outside these passes (uploads, GitHub push) keep their previous,
  unbounded behavior.
- **Backend-unavailable banner** (`LoadErrorBanner`, shared; replaces three
  identical per-app copies): `Cloud data not loaded: Portal.Startup/bootstrap
  — the server did not respond within 10s. Showing data saved on this device;
  retry or work offline.` plus Work offline / Retry / Dismiss. Local data
  keeps rendering. Retry also restores a saved session that startup could not
  restore. A startup timeout no longer clears the saved session.
- **Bootstrap failure screen** (`StartupFailureView`). A startup step that
  throws (for example a corrupt local cache) now shows the cause with Retry
  and Continue anyway, instead of a half-initialized shell.
- **Global guards** (`runGuardedApp` in each `main.dart`): `runZonedGuarded`,
  `PlatformDispatcher.instance.onError`, a chained `FlutterError.onError`, and
  a non-blank `ErrorWidget.builder` (`StartupErrorWidget`). An uncaught error
  before the first frame swaps in a minimal fallback app with Retry.
- **HTML-level fallback** in each `web/index.html`: a loading indicator under
  Flutter's view, removed on `flutter-first-frame`. A failed
  `flutter_bootstrap.js` download, a loader error or rejection, or nothing
  rendered after 20s shows an AGENTS.md §1.8 message with Reload. Base href
  and the service-worker toast are unchanged.
- §1.8 message fixes: `errorNetwork` / `errorTimeout` / `errorServer` now name
  the module/process. The HTTP layer's `Client failed to fetch, uri=...`
  became `Server request failed: <App>.HTTP/request — client failed to fetch
  ...`. The startup log lines and `timed()` failures were shaped too.

## Housekeeping (pure moves, 1000-line cap)

- `portal_app/lib/app_shell.dart` 1515 → 866 lines: `_buildPage` moved to
  `core/build_page.dart` and `_CustomSplashOverlay` to
  `components/custom_splash_overlay.dart`. Bootstrap code moved to
  `core/bootstrap.dart` in each app.
- `planner_app/lib/app_shell.dart` 1065 → 912 lines. The byte-identical
  `_WideCourseSidebarSection` copies in planner and portal became the shared
  `WideCourseSidebarSection`.

## Local deploy against the remote backend

- New `scripts/local_remote_deploy.sh up|down`. It builds the three apps
  with the existing Dockerfiles and serves them at
  `http://127.0.0.1:9068/{portal,editor,planner}/`. One nginx gateway
  (`deployment/docker/nginx/local_remote.conf.template`) is published on
  loopback only. It proxies `/api/`, `/media/`, and `/static/` to
  `https://notechondria.trance-0.com`, sending the remote Host header and
  verifying TLS.
- New env vars: `LOCAL_GATEWAY_HOST_PORT` (default 9068) and
  `REMOTE_BACKEND_ORIGIN`. See `docs/development/local_dev.md`.

## Verification

Run in `ghcr.io/cirruslabs/flutter:stable` (Flutter 3.44.0, Dart 3.12.0):

- `flutter analyze`: 0 errors in every package. The only new infos are the
  project-wide `use_string_in_part_of_directives` on the new part files and
  the moved sidebar's existing deprecations.
- `flutter test` passes in editor (17), planner (4), and portal (14).
  Shared: 67 pass. The 3 failures in `version_update_banner_test.dart` were
  already failing before this change.
- New tests: a hanging backend shows the banner (not blank), Retry recovers,
  a corrupt-cache bootstrap exception shows the failure screen (all three
  apps' `smoke_test.dart`, which CI runs), plus shared budget, banner, guard,
  and error-widget tests.
- Real-browser check (headless Firefox 128): the release builds went through
  the HEAD strip step, which reproduced `ReferenceError: e is not defined` and
  now shows the HTML fallback instead of white. Through the new strip step,
  all three apps boot and load live data from `notechondria.trance-0.com`.
  With a hanging backend the banner appears after about 10s; with a refused
  connection it appears at once. A missing `flutter_bootstrap.js` shows the
  script-download message.
- After deploy, confirm each app's `flutter_bootstrap.js` still contains
  `async load({serviceWorkerSettings:` and the bundle serves `0.1.198`.
